prompts.riverside-town: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production background panorama for a 2D side-scrolling Thai fantasy RPG. EXTREMELY WIDE panoramic composition, approximately 3072x1024, 3:1 aspect ratio. A beautiful new northern Thai Lanna settlement on the Sai River, warm late-afternoon sunlight, blue-green river winding behind wooden stilt houses, long low wooden market stalls, tiled roofs, woven awnings, hanging warm lanterns, distant limestone hills and a small golden pagoda, willow and flowering trees. Layout designed for a side-view game: one continuous CLEAR horizontal stone-and-wood promenade across the entire width at exactly 70% down the image, flat walkable ground, shop facades sit directly behind this line, no stairs or obstacles blocking it. River boats and reflections behind and below promenade, subtle river water in the lower foreground. Left end has a small ornate jade-and-gold travel arch; right end has a timber-reinforced mine entrance with turquoise ore glow. Six clear open standing spaces distributed along walkway for existing NPC sprites to be added in engine. Hand-painted polished environment art, consistent side elevation, rich natural materials, coherent scale with 100px-tall hero at game scale. Wide establishing background, NOT top-down, NOT isometric, NOT a UI mockup. No people, no creatures, no text, no labels, no UI, no watermark. Keep the street line level and uninterrupted.
prompts.rare-earth-mine: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production background panorama for a 2D side-scrolling Thai fantasy RPG. EXTREMELY WIDE panoramic composition, approximately 3072x1024, 3:1 aspect ratio. A newly discovered rare-earth mine beneath northern Thai mountains: massive underground excavation hall, natural dark slate rock, luminous turquoise monazite and violet mineral veins, copper and green crystalline seams, timber support frames, hanging amber mining lanterns, old ore carts and distant wooden hoists, shafts of light from distant entrance. Side elevation game environment, NOT top-down or isometric. One continuous CLEAR horizontal mine walkway with subtle rusty rails across the entire image at exactly 70% down the image; the upper 70% is cave scenery and mining equipment receding into depth, bottom 30% is solid rock cross-section with mineral seams. All carts and props stand behind the walkway, never block the playable corridor. No floating platforms; gameplay platforms will be added separately. Left shows reinforced entrance, right shows a huge mysterious sealed ore vault. Atmospheric polished hand-painted detailed game art, crisp readable rock shapes, strong depth, teal-violet mineral light contrasted with warm amber lamps. No characters, no monsters, no text, no UI, no watermark.
